question.:question/worked-solution:
We apply the power of quotient rule and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}\left(\frac{h}{q}\right)^{4}\left(\frac{-r}{q}\right)^{3} &= \frac{\left(h\right)^{4}}{\left(q\right)^{4}}\cdot \frac{\left(-r\right)^{3}}{\left(q\right)^{3}} \\ &= \frac{h^{4}}{q^{4}}\cdot \frac{-r^{3}}{q^{3}} \\ &= \frac{-h^{4}r^{3}}{q^{4}q^{3}} \\ &= - \frac{h^{4} r^{3}}{q^{7}}\end{aligned}
$$

Apply the product rule: $q^{4}q^{3}=q^{4+3}=q^{7}$.
